flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: [nonce, balance, codeHash, storageRoot]. EOAs sign txs (empty codeHash); contracts execute code. Four tries: world state, per-contract storage, transactions, receipts - roots committed in headers.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: Base tx 21000; SSTORE new slot 20000, update 2900 (+4800 refund zeroing); SLOAD cold 2100 / warm 100; CALL cold 2600 + 700 base; value transfer +9000; new account +25000; CREATE 32000; KECCAK 30+6/word.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: Nothing of state or logs - atomic rollback. The failed tx stays in the block and ALL gas up to failure is consumed. Reverts refund state, never gas.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: baseFee adjusts max +-12.5% per block toward 50% utilization; users pay min(maxFee, baseFee+tip); baseFee is BURNED, tip goes to proposer. Predictable pricing replaced first-price auctions (Aug 2021).

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: 128 KiB each, own fee curve with 1-wei floor, pruned after ~18 days (4096 epochs). Counts: Dencun target 3 -> Pectra 6 -> Fusaka BPO1 10/15, BPO2 14/21 (Jan 2026). Purpose: L2 data without bidding up normal txs.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: Keccak outputs and addresses fit one stack item - convenience at design time; cost: emulating 64-bit arithmetic takes multiple 256-bit ops, one reason non-EVM VMs win raw performance.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: Signatures moved out of txid-hashed serialization (kills malleability) and repriced: legacy byte = 4 weight units, witness byte = 1; block cap 4M WU => ~75% discount for signature data.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: EIP-155 embeds chainId into signing hash so signatures are network-specific; contracts add EIP-712 domain separation. Legacy pre-155 signatures remain hazardous formats.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.q: MPT account proof shape and Verkle target?
flashcards.a: Branch from header stateRoot to leaf: 3-8 nodes, KB-scale today. Verkle vector commitments target constant witnesses under ~200 bytes, enabling weak statelessness.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.q: EIP-7702 (Pectra May 2025) in one line plus risk?
flashcards.a: EOA signs a delegation to contract code executing in its context - smart-wallet features without migration; delegated contract becomes single point of compromise and revocation requires a signed tx.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: Prague added floor pricing: data-heavy txs pay >=21000 + 10*tokens where tokens = zeros(1) + nonzeros(4). Stops rollups underpaying calldata; blobs are the intended cheap lane.

flashcards.topic: Bitcoin UTXO vs Ethereum Accounts, EVM, Gas, State Trie
flashcards.a: EIP-1153 TSTORE/TLOAD (Cancun, Mar 2024): 100 gas warm, cleared at end of transaction - cheap intra-tx scratch that reverts cleanly, unlike memory+refund tricks.
